title: Browser cold first-snapshot, per-process part, decided on whole-task T_oracle on R' (922111c5)

advances.E2: terminal verdict (OWNER_DECISION / IRREDUCIBLE) or UNDECIDED for the per-process part of the browser cold first-snapshot excess on R2-10R's own binary R'
advances.E1: closes B-04's UNDECIDED per-process part (B-04 accepted at 8620ebfa2 on binary R 12b9045a)

hypothesis.H1: a Driver+Chrome process that has already served one matched-content document (warm-up kept OUTSIDE T) gives a lower T_oracle than a fresh process, by >= 1.0 ms with a 95% CI that excludes 0

source.tested_sha_note: R' = 0f1955d2f + R2-10 steps 1-8 (R2-10R accepted packet c183b95e3)
source.tree_note: The lane spec says R' has libs/cua-driver tree df2b49c3. That tree is R's BASE 0f1955d2f and equals upstream main cb685fad7's libs/cua-driver tree; R' itself (base + steps 1-8) has libs/cua-driver tree 11ee3223. Recorded as found (README Deviation 1).

browser_dir_identity.consequence: B-04's per-document verdict (IRREDUCIBLE, binary R) carries to R' by SOURCE identity of the browser snapshot path; B-04 P4 is not re-run

binary.name: cua-driver-r2-10r-a2-45dff8f32
binary.rule: existing binary R2-10R ran in every arm; never rebuilt; re-hashed at start and end; --version read inside the private session

harness.routine_note: R2-10R's scripted COMP routine lives in its packet raw/browser/scripted-routines/ (its harness/ has the configuration, r2_10_browser.py ARMS). Its 'artifact' is identical to B-04's copy (only compile_ms differs); run_b06.py asserts equality and replays R2-10R's file. verify_artifacts.py checks that the COMP arm line of run_b04.py equals the COMP line of R2-10R's r2_10_browser.py.

forced_path.configuration: R2-10R COMP, scripted chooser (mock provider, loopback only)
settings: guarded completion + compiled replay on fill (R2-10R scripted COMP artifact)
per_trial_receipts: driver_env_exp has CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1 and >= 1 mcp.inner_validation_skipped mark in the Driver trace
fill: routes[0] == 'compiled' and focus settle env 0
action routes: fill [trusted_input, dom]; toggle and modal [dom, dom]

Driver pid and Chrome browser pid (with /proc start time) recorded after the warm-up and immediately before the task navigate; warm arms: identical at both points; C: (pid, start time) pairs never repeat across trials
forced_path.smoke_configuration: B-04 DEFAULT (R2-10 BASE): feedback on, 100 ms poll, library validation, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable, 0 mcp.inner_validation_skipped marks

arms.C: cold: fresh cua-driver mcp, fresh Driver-launched Chrome (browser_prepare allow_launch, profile isolated_new, sandbox on), fresh fixture servers and token; task_start = return of the task browser_navigate
arms.Wa: warm: fresh processes and servers; OUTSIDE T: browser_navigate to B-04's matched-content sibling page (same fixture origin, same DOM structure and roles, different text and tokens), then one semantic_v2 snapshot; then the task browser_navigate in the same tab, Driver and Chrome; T starts at its return. Warm-up duration recorded separately (warmup_start -> warmup_end).
arms.Wb: identical procedure to Wa, second label
arms.P: Wa plus a harness-side 15.0 ms sleep INSIDE T between the task navigate return and the first snapshot call; actual sleep measured with CLOCK_MONOTONIC (time.monotonic_ns) and recorded
arms.Wn: descriptive only: warm process whose warm-up navigates to the sibling page WITHOUT a snapshot
arms.SMOKE: product-default configuration on R', cold, 5 per class

design.main_block: 4x4 Williams square over C/Wa/Wb/P (rc.williams(4): rows [0,1,3,2],[1,2,0,3],[2,3,1,0],[3,0,2,1]; index 0=C,1=Wa,2=Wb,3=P), first-order carry-over balanced. Round r: classes in order fill,toggle,modal (r even) or modal,toggle,fill (r odd); each class runs row (r + class index) mod 4 (fill 0, toggle 1, modal 2). fill and toggle: rounds 0-31 (8 squares, 32 rounds per class); modal: rounds 0-15 (4 squares, consistency only). Rounds 0-4 end with one SMOKE trial per class (fill, toggle, modal).
design.wn_block: separate block after the main block: rounds 0-15; per class an AB/BA pair Wn/Wa with order (r + class index) mod 2; classes fill, toggle, modal; no gate
design.fresh: everything is fresh per trial except what the arm specifies
design.chunks: each chunk = one cargo-build lock + one EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed acquisition with a 600 s cap inside it; the runner starts no round past a 480 s budget; planned main chunks rounds 0-9, 10-21, 22-31 then the wn block 0-15; rounds not started are re-run in a later chunk
design.round_attempts: a round is atomic for the load rule (checked before the round). If a round is cut (time cap, crash, session failure) its trials are kept in raw/ and reported, and the round index is re-run with attempt+1. For each (block, round) the analysis uses the first attempt in which every trial of the round ran; validity is judged inside it (failed trials stay in the denominators). Trials of cut attempts are counted separately.
design.pilot: 7 trials (plan 'pilot', SHARED lock, label b06-pilot-r00, load rule disabled with --load-max 100) ran before this PREREG to check the receipts; excluded from every analysis; it set no gate, threshold or rule

load_rule.rule: a round starts only when the 1-min loadavg (/proc/loadavg field 1) is <= 4.0; otherwise the runner waits (1 s polls) up to 60 s inside the acquisition; if still > 4.0 it ends the chunk (exit 75), both locks are released, and the remaining round indices run later
load_rule.logging: every load check (round, UTC, load1, waited_s) is written to the chunk manifest; loadavg before/after is in every trial record
load_rule.sensitivity: a sensitivity view of every gate and contrast excludes rounds containing a trial whose loadavg_before 1-min value is > 4.0

oracle.sampler: independent harness thread re-reads the jev-use fixture server state every 2 ms (B-04/R2-10 Sampler): fill submitted == token; toggle checked; modal action applied
oracle.journal: the server's CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal must show exactly one completion mutation
oracle.T_oracle: first expected-state sample at/after the caller-side return of the last accepted mutation, minus task_start (return of the task browser_navigate)

validity: b04_rows.row validity (verified outcome, exact oracle match, T_oracle present, no revert after ok, exactly 1 completion mutation, no stale dispatch, expected action routes, configuration receipts, 0 non-loopback connects, telemetry env 0) AND pids_ok AND (P: measured sleep present) AND no refusal returned as success

controls.NC_AA: per class: median paired (Wa - Wb) within [-1.0, +1.0] ms AND its 95% CI includes 0
controls.PC: per class: the 95% CI of median paired (P - Wa) excludes 0 AND its median lies in [12, 18] ms
controls.validity: per class, every main-block cell (C, Wa, Wb, P) >= 95% valid; failures stay in the denominators
controls.smoke: per class 5/5 valid SMOKE trials (no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, 0 skip marks)

statistics.pairing: paired within-round differences, (block, round, class); a pair needs both trials valid
statistics.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap of the median, 10000 resamples, a fresh random.Random(20261003) for every contrast, 95% CI = [sorted[250], sorted[9749]]

verdict_rules.precondition: computed only if NC, PC, validity and smoke pass in that class; otherwise UNDECIDED naming the failed control(s)
verdict_rules.D: median paired (C - Wa) with CI; replicate D' = median paired (C - Wb) must agree in sign with D (sign in {-1, 0, +1}; agreement = equal signs, or either is 0); disagreement -> UNDECIDED
verdict_rules.OWNER_DECISION: D >= 1.0 ms AND CI(D) excludes 0 AND D' agrees in sign -> the per-process part can be deleted only by process reuse kept outside T; owner session/process-reuse policy, sized D
verdict_rules.NOT_MATERIAL: CI(D) strictly inside (-1.0, +1.0) ms AND D' agrees in sign -> per-process part IRREDUCIBLE; the whole cold excess is IRREDUCIBLE (per-document part from B-04 + SOURCE carry)

descriptive: per-arm snapshot1 split from the phase trace: attach, DOM.getDocument (dom_get_document), Accessibility tree fetch (ax_tree) (b04_rows SUB)
B-04 E_R-form estimator span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) per arm (B-04's E_span needed a resnap1 call inside T, which would change T; not added)
warm-up cost (median warmup_start -> warmup_end) and amortized per-task cost for k = 1 and k = 5 tasks per process: median T_Wa + median warm-up / k, next to median T_C
Wn vs Wa paired (Wn - Wa) and both vs the main-block C median: is it the process or the prior snapshot that warms the path

e2_output.mapping: pre-B-06 (B-04 mapping on R'): untested = untested_ms + mean E_R'; post-B-06: OWNER_DECISION or NOT_MATERIAL -> E_R' terminal (per-document IRREDUCIBLE by B-04 + SOURCE carry; per-process OWNER_DECISION sized D, or IRREDUCIBLE), untested = untested_ms; UNDECIDED -> untested = untested_ms + mean E_R' and the share is a lower bound
e2_output.views: both views are reported: BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and counted as UNTESTED. R2-10R carries no BELOW_GATE label measured on R'; B-05's BELOW_GATE labels are on binary B5 and are cited, never combined
e2_output.never: no number from B-04 (binary R) or B-05 (binary B5) is added to or ratioed with an R' number

e4: per arm, 0 of each: stale-ref dispatch, duplicate mutation, unverified success, refusal returned as success, non-loopback connect
claim_boundary: one host, private Xvfb, Driver-chosen system Chrome (version read in session), binary R' only, scripted chooser, TypeSafe not used; the verdict covers process reuse outside T for a single task and does not design or endorse a warm pool; no product change, no new service; instrumentation is the existing env-gated phase trace
